name: Jira
label: Jira Cloud REST v3
description: Jira Cloud REST v3 via OfficialApiNode. Create/update take summary, project_key, issuetype, description (ADF), assignee_account_id and keep fields as an escape hatch. Docs: https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/intro/. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Jira official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"issue_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'issue_create', 'issue_get', 'issue_list', 'issue_update', 'issue_delete', 'issue_changelog', 'issue_notify', 'issue_transitions', 'comment_add', 'comment_get', 'comment_list', 'comment_update', 'comment_delete', 'attachment_add', 'attachment_get', 'attachment_list', 'attachment_delete', 'user_get', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'issue_create'.

schema.label: cloud_id
schema.description: Jira Cloud site UUID for /{cloud_id}/rest/api/3/…. Set on instance configurationParameters for a single site; INPUT overrides per call. Required on INPUT or in config for every HTTP operation (api_token/email stay in config only). Example: 11223344-a1b2-c3d4-e5f6-778899aabbcc.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Jira fields envelope escape hatch for issue_create/update. Purpose fields (summary, project_key, issuetype, …) merge into fields via bodyMap and win on conflict. Custom fields stay here. Example: {"customfield_10001":"x"}.

schema.label: fieldsQuery
schema.description: Comma-separated field names sent as the official query `fields` on issue_get, issue_list, and attachment_list (queryMap). Example: summary,status,assignee.

schema.label: issueIdOrKey
schema.description: Issue id or key for get/update/delete/comment/attachment/transition/notify. Example: ENG-42.

schema.label: expand
schema.description: Comma-separated expand names for issue_get. Example: renderedFields,names,schema.

schema.label: jql
schema.description: JQL for issue_list (GET /search/jql). Example: project = ENG AND status = Open.

schema.label: maxResults
schema.description: Page size for issue_list. Positive integer, Jira caps around 100. Example: 50.

schema.label: nextPageToken
schema.description: nextPageToken from a previous issue_list response.

schema.label: update
schema.description: Jira update operations map for issue_update (set/add/remove). Example: {"labels":[{"add":"urgent"}]}.

schema.label: subject
schema.description: Email subject for issue_notify. Example: Ticket updated.

schema.label: textBody
schema.description: Plain-text body for issue_notify.

schema.label: htmlBody
schema.description: HTML body for issue_notify.

schema.label: body
schema.description: Comment ADF document for comment_add / comment_update. Official `body`. Example: {"type":"doc","version":1,"content":[{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Looks good"}]}]}.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Comment id or attachment id for get/update/delete. Example: 10001.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Files for attachment_add. Platform file list [{mime_type, source, data, name}]. Multipart part name file; header X-Atlassian-Token: no-check.

schema.label: accountId
schema.description: Atlassian accountId query for user_get. Example: 5b10a0e36f05b20025ab4ad0.

schema.label: summary
schema.description: Issue summary (title). Wired to fields.summary on issue_create and issue_update. Example: Cannot reset password.

schema.label: project_key
schema.description: Project key. Wired to fields.project.key on issue_create / issue_update. Example: ENG. Use project_id instead when you have the numeric id.

schema.label: project_id
schema.description: Project id. Wired to fields.project.id on issue_create / issue_update. Example: 10001.

schema.label: issuetype
schema.description: Issue type name. Wired to fields.issuetype.name on issue_create / issue_update. EXACT typical: Task | Bug | Story | Epic | Sub-task. Example: Task.

schema.label: issuetype_id
schema.description: Issue type id. Wired to fields.issuetype.id on issue_create / issue_update. Example: 10004.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Issue description as Atlassian Document Format (API v3). Wired to fields.description on issue_create / issue_update. Example: {"type":"doc","version":1,"content":[{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Steps"}]}]}.

schema.label: assignee_account_id
schema.description: Assignee Atlassian accountId. Wired to fields.assignee.accountId on issue_create / issue_update. Example: 5b10a0e36f05b20025ab4ad0.

schema.label: reporter_account_id
schema.description: Reporter Atlassian accountId. Wired to fields.reporter.accountId on issue_create / issue_update.

schema.label: priority
schema.description: Priority name. Wired to fields.priority.name on issue_create / issue_update. Typical: Highest | High | Medium | Low | Lowest. Example: High.

schema.label: labels
schema.description: Label strings. Wired to fields.labels on issue_create / issue_update. Example: ["checkout","p1"].

schema.label: parent_key
schema.description: Parent issue key for sub-tasks. Wired to fields.parent.key on issue_create / issue_update. Example: ENG-12.

schema.label: duedate
schema.description: Due date YYYY-MM-DD. Wired to fields.duedate on issue_create / issue_update. Example: 2026-11-15.

schema.label: components
schema.description: Component objects [{id}] or [{name}]. Wired to fields.components on issue_create / issue_update.

schema.label: visibility_type
schema.description: Comment visibility type for comment_add / comment_update. Wired to visibility.type. EXACT: role | group. Example: role.

schema.label: visibility_value
schema.description: Comment visibility value (role or group name) for comment_add / comment_update. Wired to visibility.value. Example: Administrators.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: issue_create, issue_get, issue_list, issue_update, issue_delete, issue_changelog, issue_notify, issue_transitions, comment_add, comment_get, comment_list, comment_update, comment_delete, attachment_add, attachment_get, attachment_list, attachment_delete, user_get, listen. Default: issue_create. Example: issue_create.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=basic (configKey api_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Email
configurationParameters.description: Basic-auth username field (email). Atlassian account email for API-token basic auth. Example: 'ops@example.com'.

configurationParameters.label: Cloud Id
configurationParameters.description: Jira Cloud site UUID for api.atlassian.com/ex/jira/{cloud_id}/…. Required for HTTP calls unless INPUT cloud_id overrides per invoke. Example: 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Secret
configurationParameters.description: Jira Cloud webhook secret for constant-time X-Hub-Signature (sha256=...) HMAC-SHA256 verification. Never logged.
